display_long_description:
Your room scan becomes the battlefield. Something knocks behind your wall – then it bursts open. An alien lander touches down on your floor and little monsters pour in, hopping onto your couch, hiding behind your table and splitting in two if you let them. Too many in the room at once and it's game over.

THE FREE PROLOGUE – 15 WAVES
• Monsters that use your real walls, furniture and ceiling
• A blackout where your blasters become flashlights
• A shark in your living room
• Cloaked monsters you only see with thermal vision
• A thunderstorm inside your room, zero gravity and a comic wave
• An asteroid boss – and a mothership that plays tennis with you
• Thieves, monster towers, balloons and a very rare golden monster

ALSO IN THE GAME
• BOOT CAMP: a friendly alien teaches you everything in a minute
• ARENA: replay special waves and bosses and chase best times
• Party high score list with names – pass the headset around
• A wardrobe with funny outfits, and a few secret ones
• Comfort: seated mode, reduced flashes, volume settings

We're a two-person indie team and this is our first game. The full game with more waves, more bosses and an endless mode is in the works – tell us how the prologue plays in your room!

Requires a room scan (Space Setup). Play in a clear area – some waves make you turn, step aside and duck.
